column1: # vectors for the port of the generic-api-key rule: name, key, value spec, verdict of the real binary (hit or none). A value spec is parts joined by +: a literal, r:<alphabet>:<length>:<seed> (a deterministic run of characters; alphabets alnum, hex, letters, lower, digits, url, or s<chars>), or u:uuid:<seed>. Values are made at run time; no secret-shaped text is in this file.
